text: @jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card 是 DSH Web 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 余额与计费信息卡片。它将 Host 拉取的价目表、节假日日历和可用的开放平台余额通过本地数据路由提供给界面，并读取当前会话的模型和提供商。卡片显示账号或 API 余额、所选模型的输入/缓存/输出单价、高峰与空闲状态及切换倒计时，并在中文界面标记节假日和调休日。价格按界面语言显示人民币或美元，数据源不可用时使用内置快照。开放平台余额需要配置 DeepSeek API Key。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card adds a billing card to the DSH Web sidebar. It shows account or API balance, selected model prices, peak or idle status, and a countdown. Prices follow UI language; built-in data is used when upstream data is unavailable. An optional DeepSeek API key enables API balance.
想在 DSH 侧边栏里随时看 DeepSeek 账户余额和模型单价
DSH 能显示现在是高峰还是空闲计费吗？
Show the current DeepSeek model prices and billing period in my DSH sidebar.
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card 的功能「余额卡片」：在 DSH Web 侧边栏底部显示 DSH 账号余额或 DeepSeek 开放平台余额，并随提供商选择切换；余额定期刷新。
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card 的功能「模型计价与时段」：根据当前模型展示 DeepSeek 官方输入、缓存和输出单价，并显示高峰/空闲状态及倒计时；中文界面还标注节假日和调休日。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · dsh-billing-card：A card in the DSH sidebar footer: the balance, the provider and model behind it, their unit prices, and the current billing period with a countdown to the next switch.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Features：- **Balance** — the DSH account balance (recharge + bonus) or the DeepSeek open-platform balance behind your API key, whichever the selected provider bills; it follows the provider in the composer.
- **Row per fact** — the provider names the row above the model, so you can see which channel the price belongs to.
- **Unit prices** — input, cached and output for the selected model, in the tier active now; no price when another provider serves the model.
- **Billing period** — green `Idle` / yellow `Peak`; the countdown to the switch sits top-left, keeps its `Peak in` / `Idle in` wording and takes the period's colour.
- **Holidays** (Chinese UI) — a blue strip with the holiday's name, and a gray `调休` (*Make-up*) chip on a make-up workday.
- **Currency by language** — CNY prices in Chinese, USD everywhere else.
- **Theme and locale** — light and dark themes from the card's own token layer, zh/en dictionaries, built-in data when an upstream cannot be fetched.
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Screenshots：Real render, 256 px sidebar at 2× density.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Installation：The package is published on npm ([`@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card`](https://npmx.dev/package/@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card)) as a DSH bundle. Use the profile you actually run (`desktop` for the desktop app, `web` for `dsh web`):

Requires DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 or newer — `package.json` declares the range in `engines.dsh`, and the
manifest fields, the footer slot, and the `locale` and `webServer` services it uses all exist in
that release.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card
```

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Installation：The same as **Install from npm** on the DSH plugin page. Refresh the GUI afterwards — the card appears at the bottom of the sidebar and hides itself when the sidebar is collapsed to the icon rail.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> A plugin's Host half loads once per application start, so **restart the application after installing or upgrading**. Until then the card runs on its built-in data.

Requires a DSH build with the Web GUI, the sidebar footer slot and the account service. To uninstall:

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · How it works：The Host half fetches both price tables and the China mainland holiday calendar once per application start and serves them on `GET /deepseek-billing-card/data`; the Client half is a React component in `sidebar.footer.action` that reads that route, follows the composer's model picker, and refreshes the balance every 30 s.

Switching to the provider that bills the open platform asks the Host for a fresh balance at once, so the amount follows the switch instead of the next tick.
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Billing window：Peak is Beijing time, Monday to Friday, 09:00–12:00 and 14:00–18:00, excluding Chinese statutory holidays; everything else is idle.
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Currency：A Chinese UI quotes the CNY page, every other language the USD page. Nothing is converted; the balance keeps its wallet currency.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Hover text：Each row's trigger is the thing the row is about: the balance amount itself (help cursor, **no**
underline — the number is already the loudest element on the card, and a dashed rule under it reads
as a link), the model name (dashed, so the affordance is visible), and the chips (the period
always, `Make-up` in the Chinese UI), each with the help cursor. The model bubble belongs to the
official price list only: with another provider the numbers are a reference, not that provider's
rates.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Hover text：- **Balance** — what the headline adds up to: recharge, bonus, and how often it is re-read. The
  open-platform balance reads the same way and never mentions the account.
- **Model** — a price quote needs four facts, so it states four: the model id, the unit, the
  snapshot date, and how those numbers were obtained (`startup` or `snapshot`).

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Hover text：The period chip lists the peak window (Monday–Friday `09:00-12:00`, then `14:00-18:00`),
everything the peak leaves idle, and where the calendar comes from; in the Chinese UI the `Make-up`
chip says how a make-up workday is billed (idle all day, like a weekend). No bubble repeats a number
the card already shows. The price block and the holiday banner have no hover text — their text already says
what they are. The bubble waits 240 ms, flips below the trigger when there is no room above, and
closes on leave, blur, or `Esc`.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Data sources：| What | Source |
| --- | --- |
| Account balance, model | DSH account service; the composer's model selection |
| Open-platform balance | `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`, authorised with the `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` credential the Models page stores (the launch environment is the fallback) |
| Prices | <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/> and <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/> |
| Holidays | <https://calendars.icloud.com/holidays/cn_zh.ics> |

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Limits：- Prices and holidays are read once per application start; the open-platform balance is re-read every 30 s. A provider switch re-reads it right away.
- Without a `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` the card shows the account balance; signed out of the DSH account it
  shows the open-platform balance instead of a blank.
- A model served by a provider other than DeepSeek's own shows no price.
- Verified end to end on DSH 0.2.1-rc.3; against 0.2.0-rc.1 the source surface is the same, though
  that build does not read `engines.dsh` yet.
- The card needs the HTTP GUI (`dsh web`); without a web server it runs on the built-in copies, and without the `uiSession` / `modelDirectories` services it prices the catalog default.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Development：No build step: `client.js` is a hand-written browser module, `index.js` and `parse.js` are the Host half. The card renders only its own subtree and resolves every colour from its own `--dbc-*` layer, so it follows the app's light/dark setting without reading a host variable.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Development：```
package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
cordis.patch.yml    # inserts the dsh-billing-card entry
index.js parse.js   # Host half: startup fetch + the data route
client.js           # Client half: the card and its built-in fallbacks

To run a local checkout instead of the published package, add the folder — it is linked into the profile, so `client.js` edits show up on a page refresh:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-billing-card
```

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · Development：`npm test` runs the offline suite: the parsers against the pages captured in `test/fixtures`, the Host route with a stubbed upstream, and the Client half in a miniature React runtime. No dependencies, no network. `AGENTS.md` holds the working spec, and `.agents/skills/` holds the four project skills for agents.

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 功能：- **余额** —— DSH 账号余额（充值 + 赠金）或 API Key 对应的 DeepSeek 开放平台余额，按当前提供商的计费方式显示，随输入框切换。
- **一行一事** —— 提供商单独一行、模型名另起一行，价格属于哪个渠道一眼可见。
- **档单价** —— 当前模型在现行时段的输入、缓存、输出价格；其他渠道提供的模型不显示价格。
- **计费时段** —— 绿色「空闲」/ 黄色「高峰」；切换倒计时在左上角，保留「距高峰 / 距空闲」字样并用当前时段同色。
- **假期标识**（中文界面）—— 假期显示蓝色横条和假期名，调休日显示灰色「调休」标签。
- **按界面语言计价** —— 中文界面人民币价，其他语言美元价。
- **跟随应用** —— 卡片自带 token 层的明暗主题、中英文字典，抓不到上游数据时用内置数据。
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 截图：真实渲染，侧边栏 256 px、2× 密度。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 安装：已发布到 npm（[`@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card`](https://npmx.dev/package/@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card)），是一个 DSH bundle。用你实际运行的 profile（桌面应用用 `desktop`，`dsh web` 用 `web`）：

需要 DSH 0.2.0-rc.1 或更新版本——`engines.dsh` 声明了这个范围；卡片用到的 manifest 字段、页脚插槽、`locale` 与 `webServer` 服务在该版本中都已存在。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card
```

等同于 DSH 插件页上的 **Install from npm**。装完刷新 GUI —— 卡片出现在侧边栏底部；侧边栏收成图标栏时卡片隐藏。

> [!IMPORTANT]
> 插件的 Host 半边每次启动只加载一次，所以**安装或升级后要重启一次应用**。重启之前卡片用内置数据。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 安装：需要带 Web GUI、侧边栏底部插槽和账号服务的 DSH。卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card
```

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 工作原理：Host 半边在每次启动时拉取两份价目表和中国大陆节假日日历，通过 `GET /deepseek-billing-card/data` 提供；Client 半边是 `sidebar.footer.action` 里的 React 组件，读取该路由、跟随输入框的模型选择，并每 30 秒刷新一次余额。

切到由开放平台计费的提供商时，卡片会立刻让 Host 重读一次余额，金额随切换生效，不用等下一个刷新周期。
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 计费时段：高峰是北京时间周一至周五 09:00–12:00 和 14:00–18:00，中国法定节假日除外；其余为空闲时段。
@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 货币：中文界面用人民币价目表，其他语言用美元价目表。不做汇率换算，余额保持钱包自身的货币。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 悬停提示：悬停挂在每行的「本体」上：余额数字本身（只给帮助光标，**不加下划线** —— 数字已经是卡片上最响的
元素，再加一条虚线会被读成链接）、模型名（虚线，标出可悬停），以及两个标签（时段、调休，各自带
帮助光标）。模型名的提示只在官方价目渠道下出现：换了别的服务商，卡片上的数字只是参考价，不是它的
报价。

每个气泡都是卡片自己画的「明细表」—— 不借用宿主的图元，所以它跟着主题走，而不是继承一块固定的
深色底板：每个事实一行「名称 → 取值」（充值是绿点，赠金是黄点），再来一条分隔线，最后是浅色的脚注。

- **余额** —— 屏幕上那个数字由什么组成：充值、赠金、多久刷新一次。开放平台余额同样读法，
  而且绝不会提到账号余额。
- **模型** —— 一条报价要说清四件事，就说四件：模型 ID、计价单位、快照日期、数字是怎么来的
  （「启动时校准」还是「内置快照」）。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 悬停提示：时段标签列出高峰窗口（周一至周五 `09:00-12:00`，再一行 `14:00-18:00`）、高峰之外剩下的时段，
以及日历来源；「调休」标签说明调休日如何计费（像周末一样全天不计高峰）。气泡不会重复卡片上已有的
数字。价格区和假期横条没有悬停提示 —— 文字已经说明了自己。气泡在 240ms 后出现，上方放不下时翻到
下方，移开、失焦或按 `Esc` 立即收起。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 数据来源：| 内容 | 来源 |
| --- | --- |
| 账号余额、模型 | DSH 账号服务；输入框的模型选择 |
| 开放平台余额 | `GET https://api.deepseek.com/user/balance`，用 Models 页保存的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 凭据（启动环境是回退） |
| 价格 | <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing/> 与 <https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing/> |
| 节假日 | <https://calendars.icloud.com/holidays/cn_zh.ics> |

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 已知边界：- 价目与节假日在每次启动时读取一次；开放平台余额每 30 秒重新读取。切换提供商时立即重读。
- 没有配置 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 时显示账号余额；DSH 账号未登录时改显示开放平台余额，而不是留空。
- 非 DeepSeek 官方渠道提供的模型不显示价格。
- 已在 DSH 0.2.1-rc.3 上端到端验证；对 0.2.0-rc.1 而言源码层面的接口一致，只是该版本还不读 `engines.dsh`。
- 卡片需要 HTTP GUI（`dsh web`）；没有 web 服务器时用内置数据，缺少 `uiSession` / `modelDirectories` 服务时按目录默认模型计价。

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 开发：无构建步骤：`client.js` 是手写的浏览器模块，`index.js` 与 `parse.js` 是 Host 半边。卡片只渲染自己的子树，颜色全部由自己的 `--dbc-*` 变量解析，不读宿主主题变量。

```
package.json        # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client
cordis.patch.yml    # 插入 dsh-billing-card 条目
index.js parse.js   # Host 半边：启动抓取 + 数据路由
client.js           # Client 半边：卡片与内置回退数据

想在本地跑而不是用已发布的包，把文件夹加进去 —— 它会以链接方式装进 profile，改 `client.js` 刷新页面即生效：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-billing-card
```

@jimmyzm/dsh-billing-card README · 开发：`npm test` 跑离线测试：解析器跑 `test/fixtures` 里抓下来的页面，Host 路由用桩上游，Client 半边跑在迷你 React 运行时里。无依赖、不联网。`AGENTS.md` 里是开发规范，`.agents/skills/` 里是四个项目 skill。
